meta.title: Audit Log — Same Detail, Different Scope (decision 106)

cards.title: Scope is the only difference (decision 106)
items: The Audit Log tab shows identical full detail to all three roles — Examiner, Lead/Approver, and Auditor never see a redacted or summarized version of the same log

The real distinction is reach, not content: Examiner/Lead-Approver only reach it from within an examination they're assigned to, while Auditor gets a portfolio-wide, cross-examination view as their effective landing page — they hold no drafting/sign-off role that needs the per-examination workspace otherwise

cards.title: Diagram scope
items: Covers only the access-scope split, not the log's schema or retention policy — see ADR-0024 for data retention/lifecycle and audit access
The Auditor's landing page is also drawn in lfi-examiner-dashboard-userflow-v1.html's navigation flow, not repeated here
